title: GP--RL--MPC: Uncertainty-Aware Reinforcement Learning-Augmented Model Predictive Control with Gaussian Process Postdecision State-Value Functions
abstract: arXiv:2611.22038v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We propose Gaussian Process Reinforcement Learning-Augmented Model Predictive Control (GP--RL--MPC), which uses a learned critic as the MPC terminal penalty to account for costs beyond the prediction horizon. Gaussian process regression (GPR) enables data-efficient critic learning from limited, noisy rollouts within optimistic approximate policy iteration (OAPI), with soft updates mitigating policy chattering. A tunable risk coefficient weights GP epistemic uncertainty in the terminal cost, regulating sensitivity to uncertain critic predictions. The postdecision state formulation shifts disturbance averaging offline to account for aleatoric uncertainty from the terminal transition onward. Under matching objectives and admissible actions, a one-step horizon recovers greedy value-space RL. translated_title: GP-RL-MPC：基于高斯过程后决策状态值函数的不确定性感知强化学习增强模型预测控制
translated_abstract: 我们提出高斯过程强化学习增强模型预测控制（GP-RL-MPC），该方法使用学习得到的评论家函数作为MPC的终端惩罚项，以考虑预测时域之外的成本。高斯过程回归（GPR）能够在乐观近似策略迭代（OAPI）框架内，从有限且有噪声的rollout轨迹中实现数据高效的评论家学习，并通过软更新机制缓解策略抖动问题。一个可调的风险系数对终端成本中的GP认知不确定性进行加权，从而调节对不确定评论家预测的敏感度。后决策状态公式将扰动平均处理转移到离线进行，以从终端转移开始考虑偶然不确定性。在目标一致且动作可容许的条件下，单步时域可退化为贪婪值空间强化学习。在通过精确边际似然拟合GP超参数后，我们利用诱导点构建稀疏的确定性训练条件（DTC）后验。
tldr: 该论文提出GP-RL-MPC方法，以高斯过程回归学习的不确定性感知评论家函数作为模型预测控制的终端惩罚项，数据高效地考虑预测时域之外的成本，并通过可调风险系数在认知不确定性与偶然不确定性之间实现权衡。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes GP-RL-MPC, which employs a Gaussian process regression-learned uncertainty-aware critic as the MPC terminal penalty to data-efficiently account for costs beyond the prediction horizon, with a tunable risk coefficient trading off epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty.
